title: ERRORS LEAVE THE SCREEN
why: His order of 2026-10-09: the raid text reads like a shooter HUD, and none of them print a program error on the screen. A crash said Something broke and up to 80 characters of the raw error, and a draw fault said Render fault logged and its raw text. The raw text now goes to the run report only, and the screen gets one row per raid, ERROR SAVED TO YOUR RUN REPORT. The two slow frame lines are short caps rows with the setting to change underneath, still once a session.
now: A game error no longer prints its raw text on the screen; one row says it was saved to your run report.

edits.anchor: if(!crashTold){ crashTold=true; say('Something broke: '+msg.slice(0,80)+'. It was written into your run report.'); }
edits.replacement: errRow('ERROR  \u00b7  '+msg.slice(0,80));   // v22.xx (R36): the raw text to the run report, one row on the screen
errRow('RENDER FAULT  \u00b7  '+G.drawErr);   // v22.xx (R36): the raw text to the run report, one row on the screen

edits.anchor: say('Wall glitch logged in your run report.');
edits.replacement: say('WALL GLITCH SAVED TO RUN REPORT','sys');   // v22.xx (R36): a system row in caps

edits.anchor: if(!DRS.said){ DRS.said=1; try{ sayWhenFree('Running slowly: the render resolution stepped down on its own. Settings has Auto resolution and Effects.'); }catch(_ds){} }
edits.replacement: if(!DRS.said){ DRS.said=1; try{ sayWhenFree('RESOLUTION STEPPED DOWN','sys',{sub:'Running slowly. Auto resolution in Settings.'}); }catch(_ds){} }   // v22.xx (R36): a system row in caps

edits.anchor: if(slow*2>PERF.win.length){ PERF.said=1; try{ sayWhenFree('Running slowly? Settings has Render resolution and Effects to lighten the load.'); }catch(_ps){} return true; }
